title: Ahaziah (king of Israel)
summary: Son of Ahab, king of Israel.
description: Son of Ahab, king of Israel. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-16 (Table 2, "The Kings of Qatna").

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (CFAH non-anchor dates). No tier 1–4 birth year. The year is the reign-start figure already printed on dates.reign: Reign: 898-896. Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-11-13): was none.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-16: The Kings of Israel and Judah," OSF preprint v1.3 (5 May 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/YV29C, file CFAH-16_ The Kings of Israel and Judah_v1.3.pdf, Table 2 "The Kings of Qatna", pp. 13–14
reign.note: Row "Akizzi = Ahaziah" of Table 2 (Kings of Qatna = kings of Israel (CFAH-16)).
